title: Jibu's Failed Water Pilots and the 2014 Restart in Kigali
conflicts: Number of 2013 pilots: Galen Welsch's own October 2013 NextBillion article says four (two in Kampala, one in Kigali, one in DR Congo); Unreasonable (2014) and the SSIR podcast (2021) say three, one per country. The story gives no count of its own and keeps 'all three' only inside Galen's quotation. Founders' early money: SSIR says half a million dollars of their own; an uncited 2016 blog says $30,000; the story gives no figure. Media Muvuna's start: SSIR says both 2014 and 2015; the story calls her an early reseller and dates only her 2021 position. Later scale: SSIR 2021 about 150 franchises in seven countries vs New Times 2026 over 200 in eight; the story uses the 2021 figure with its date.
notes: Episode changed from the slate's founding decision to the documented setback: the 'just kidding' trip of March 2013, the failed 2013 pilots (on the founders' later SSIR account; contemporary 2013-14 pieces report no failure), and the 2014 relaunch in Kigali and Kampala. Co-founder Randy Welsch (Galen's father) added to founder. Funding 'mixed': self-funded pilots, then private investors and foundations. Randy's 2013 letters are company-archive pages on jibuco.com whose URL slugs do not match their titles.
